_comment: settings-continuidade.template.json — parameterized deny-rules for the continuity strict mode. ADDITIVE: merge into the 'deny' array that already exists in settings.json/settings.local.json. Without this, strict mode can be disarmed by the session itself (whatever edits settings is exactly what continuity is trying to protect).
_uso: Copy the 'deny' array above INTO the 'permissions.deny' that already exists (never replace the whole file). '${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}' does not apply here — deny paths are always relative to the target project. The profile setting 'continuidade.enforcement: strict' in operator-profile.yaml turns on the RECOMMENDATION to apply this block; applying it is always a human gate (the classifier blocks auto-edits of settings).
